title: ModernPath workspace↔server sync batch (v1)
description: Ordinary workspace-to-server document sync batch. Process and requirement state is authored directly in the server store.

schema_version.description: Absent = the pre-versioning wire shape, treated as 1. Unsupported values are rejected 422 {message, supported} before any write.

provenance.description: derived = written by a derivation pass; guide = a human-written lens the pass reads as input; authored = maintained by hand. This is what separates a repository-synced explanation from an upload and from generated per-module documentation (USER:2026-08-13).

id.description: Existing document primary key for an update; omit to create.

upsert_document_payload.description: One System-scoped explanatory document or discovery guide. Native document IDs identify stored documents; source paths are provenance metadata.
